claim.supported_scope: One reflective-reflective disjoint two-stage higher-order construct formed from at least two measured, measurement-only lower-order components and connected by exactly one higher-order-to-measured-outcome structural path in a standardized path-weighted PLS model.
claim.estimand: Stage-two higher-order composite weights and loadings over generated lower-order component-score indicators and the single higher-order-to-outcome structural path coefficient.
assumptions: The lower-order components are reflective measured constructs and are measurement-only in the stage-two structural model.
Stage-one component scores are generated from the same complete-case data, standardized preprocessing, path weighting, and frozen PLS implementation.
Exactly one indicator-free higher-order placeholder and one outgoing path to a measured outcome define the native bounded workflow.
exclusions: Repeated-indicator and hybrid authoring remain backend/reference capabilities and are excluded from this native promotion contract.
Formative higher-order relationships, multiple or nested higher-order constructs, incoming HOC paths, and arbitrary HOC systems are excluded.
HOC bootstrap, permutation, confidence intervals, interactions, case weights, and nonstandardized or PCA settings are excluded.
warnings: The generated stage-two indicators are estimated component scores and their uncertainty is not propagated in this point-estimate contract.
This bounded two-stage workflow must not be described as support for every higher-order PLS model.

equations.expression: eta_H = Z_H w_H with w_H from the frozen stage-two PLS iteration

references.citation: Becker, Klein, and Wetzels (2012), Hierarchical Latent Variable Models in PLS-SEM: Guidelines for Using Reflective-Formative Type Models, Long Range Planning 45(5-6), 359-394
Independent Python stage-one score generation and stage-two higher-order PLS fixture

simulations.design: One reflective-reflective HOC with two to four lower-order components over bounded loadings, component correlations, HOC path effects, sample sizes, and reliability levels.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen scenario-indexed generators; QuickPLS and the independent implementation receive identical data and component order.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Mapped paths, loadings, and weights must agree with the independent two-stage reference within 1e-6, supported models must converge at the preregistered rate, and component permutation must degrade the HOC signal.

boundaries.case: A lower-order component cannot produce a finite nonconstant stage-one score or stage two is singular.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Execution fails with the affected component identified and emits no completed HOC result.

boundaries.case: The recipe contains multiple HOCs, fewer than two components, formative components, a non-two-stage method, incoming HOC paths, or more than one outgoing HOC path.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Native setup or typed recipe validation blocks execution and names the unsupported shape.

boundaries.case: Rows, construct declarations, and lower-order component declarations are consistently reordered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Canonicalized HOC paths and mapped component estimates remain equal within tolerance.

boundaries.case: The same data fingerprint and two-stage recipe are executed repeatedly.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Generated indicator identities and the analytical HOC payload are exactly equal apart from operational identifiers and timestamps.

boundaries.case: A component mapping, generated score identity, HOC weight, loading, path, method setting, or version is altered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive instead of displaying the changed higher-order result.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a result whose higher-order capability identity differs from its recipe.
Reject a HOC result relabeled with an unsupported PLS method version or HOC method.
Reject a HOC result whose saved dataset fingerprint no longer matches.
Reject any modified archive member whose checksum differs.
Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, leaked or inconsistent generated identities, non-finite values, or incomplete HOC estimates.
Never reinterpret repeated-indicator, hybrid, broader, or unversioned HOC output as the bounded native two-stage workflow.

persistence.legacy_policy: Only the exact current recipe shape and pls_pm_v1 result regenerated or strictly loaded as a disjoint two-stage HOC may satisfy this feature contract.

native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For the same canonical two-stage HOC recipe, dataset fingerprint, and PLS method version, GUI and CLI generated component-score identities and analytical results must be exactly equal apart from operational identifiers and timestamps.
accessibility_rules: Component relationships, HOC paths, and method scope are available in accessible tables without exposing generated pseudo-indicator names.
Dialog validation and exclusions are associated with controls and do not rely on canvas position or color.
